pros.example: a stable product line runs months of routine batches on the strength of one qualification file

pros.claim: A written trigger list turns 'has anything changed' from a memory exercise into a checklist anyone can run
pros.example: a bath rebuild automatically schedules a qualification lot instead of being noticed three batches later

cons.claim: Qualification lots consume parts, witnesses, gold and a full day of attention, which is a real barrier to running them often enough
cons.example: a small product variation is quietly treated as the same product because a fresh qualification would cost more than the order is worth

cons.claim: Trigger lists can be gamed by narrow interpretation, since almost any change can be argued to be minor
cons.example: a substituted brightener is called a like-for-like replacement to avoid requalifying, and the next batch behaves differently

failure_modes: running production on a qualification whose stack, chemistry or rack no longer exists
treating a geometry variant as the qualified product
requalifying without retaining the witnesses that make the file useful
leaving the trigger list unwritten so ageing is invisible
acceptance_tests: each product has a dated qualification file with full thickness and adhesion results and retained witnesses, and the written trigger list is present in it
every batch record references the qualification it relies on, and any triggering change since that date has an associated requalification
revisit_triggers: any item on the trigger list occurs
a routine batch fails against a qualification that had been stable
a product variant is introduced under an existing product name

base.update_signal: a routine batch fails against a previously stable qualification, or a change on the trigger list occurs without a requalification lot

nodes.definition: Translate what was measured into the language of the claim classes without ever becoming the person who approves the word. Every marketing term for a plated article is a compliance class with conditions attached, and the conditions are of three kinds: a minimum coating thickness, a minimum fineness of the gold, and sometimes a required base metal or construction. The US FTC Jewelry Guides class separates flashed or washed goods from electroplate and from heavy electroplate by thickness and requires a minimum fineness for the gold used; vermeil additionally requires a sterling silver base, which means a steel-cored or base-metal piece can never carry that word no matter how much gold is on it; and gold filled or rolled gold plate describe mechanically clad stock that an electroplating process does not produce at all. The ISO 27874 class covers gold and gold-alloy coatings for jewellery with its own grades. The bench's job is to say which class the measured evidence would support, what evidence is still missing, and which conditions the piece structurally cannot meet - and then hand that to whoever in the business signs claims, after the current rules of the selling jurisdiction have been verified. This gate flags; it does not approve.

included: mapping measured thickness and fineness onto claim classes
base-metal and construction conditions that make a class impossible
identifying missing evidence for a class
flagging claim-shaped language for the compliance signer
requiring verification of current jurisdiction rules
excluded: approving or signing any label or marketing claim
asserting numeric thresholds from memory
hallmarking and marking procedures
issuing accredited fineness or release certificates

pros.claim: Mapping early stops a product being sold under a word its construction can never support
pros.example: a base-metal cored piece is flagged as permanently outside the vermeil class at quotation rather than after the tags are printed

pros.claim: It converts a legal-sounding question into a concrete evidence gap the shop can close
pros.example: a claim is held pending an accredited fineness result rather than being argued about

cons.claim: The classes differ by jurisdiction and change over time, so the map is only as good as its last verification
cons.example: a product line sold into a second country needs its wording checked again against that country's rules before the same tag is used

cons.claim: Flagging rather than approving frustrates a shop that wants a single person to decide everything quickly
cons.example: an urgent listing waits on the compliance signer even though the bench already knows what the measurements show

failure_modes: reciting a threshold from memory instead of verifying the current rule
letting the bench approve wording because the compliance signer is slow
applying one jurisdiction's ladder to goods sold in another
describing a measured result in words that imply a class it has not been shown to meet
acceptance_tests: each product's claim file records the measured thickness and fineness evidence, the class those numbers would support, the conditions still unmet, and the date the jurisdiction's rules were verified
no label or listing wording is released without a recorded decision by the designated compliance signer
revisit_triggers: the shop sells into a new jurisdiction
the applicable guides or standards are revised
a product's stack, base metal or measured thickness changes
a marketplace or retailer imposes its own claim wording rules

base.update_signal: the jurisdiction's guides or standards are revised, a new selling market is entered, or a product's stack or measured thickness changes

nodes.definition: Draw the line between numbers the shop generates for its own process control and numbers that can support a claim to a buyer or a regulator, and schedule the second kind deliberately. In-house measurement is excellent at detecting drift and catching bad batches, and it is not a substitute for accredited testing where a regulation or a trade buyer requires it. The routine send-out set for plated jewellery is small and predictable: nickel release for skin-contact articles to the EN 1811 class, run with the EN 12472 wear-and- corrosion simulation because a coated article has to be tested as it will be after wear rather than as it leaves the tank; conformant corrosion exposure to the ISO 9227 / ASTM B117 class, since a home-built fog box controls none of the variables the standard controls and its hours are not comparable; and fire-assay arbitration to the ISO 11426 class through a refiner when fineness is genuinely disputed. These are per-product-and-process obligations rather than per-batch ones, which makes them affordable, but they carry weeks of lead time and therefore belong in the product launch plan. The certificates are filed against the product line and refreshed whenever the stack or chemistry changes.

included: the in-house versus claimable distinction
the standard send-out set and what each is for
per-product-and-process scheduling and lead time
filing and refreshing certificates against the product line
excluded: performing accredited testing in-house or approximating it
quoting comparative in-house results as standard hours
approving the claim the certificate supports
medical or regulatory advice to a customer

pros.claim: Scheduling send-outs at launch turns a blocking legal requirement into a known lead time instead of an emergency
pros.example: a skin-contact line has its release testing under way while the first production batches are still being qualified

pros.claim: An accredited certificate is the only evidence that survives a buyer's or regulator's scrutiny, so it ends whole categories of argument
pros.example: a trade buyer's compliance questionnaire is answered with the certificate rather than with shop measurements

cons.claim: Send-out testing costs money and weeks, which pushes small shops to postpone it until a buyer demands it
cons.example: a product ships into a regulated market before its release testing is back, creating exposure that was entirely foreseeable

cons.claim: A certificate covers the product and process it was issued for, so it silently expires in meaning when either changes
cons.example: a chemistry substitution leaves a filed certificate describing a stack the shop no longer produces

failure_modes: quoting an in-house comparative screen as if it were a standard-class result
treating a certificate as permanent after a stack or chemistry change
entering a regulated market with the testing still unscheduled
letting a home-built exposure box generate hour-based claims
acceptance_tests: each product line's file lists which claims require accredited evidence, the tests scheduled or received, and the stack and process each certificate covers
no customer-facing or buyer-facing claim cites an in-house screen where an accredited class is required
revisit_triggers: a stack, chemistry or process change invalidates the coverage of a filed certificate
a new market or trade buyer imposes additional testing
the applicable test standard or regulation is revised

base.update_signal: a stack or chemistry change invalidates a filed certificate's coverage, or a new market or buyer imposes additional accredited testing

nodes.definition: Answer the question every customer actually asks - how long will this last - without inventing the answer. Wear life is not a property of the coating alone; it is the interaction of thickness, deposit hardness, the geometry that rubs, skin chemistry, cosmetics and cleaning habits, and how often the piece is worn, which is why no honest bench can convert a measured thickness into a number of months. What the bench can say is structured and true: the measured thickness at the worst-case zone with its method, the wear class that thickness corresponds to, a qualitative expectation for that class expressed as a band rather than a promise, the specific things that shorten it, and the care that extends it. Anything stronger is a warranty decision for the business, not a technical statement from the bench. Two hard lines sit here: a plated article is never described or allowed to be understood as solid gold, and where a piece is an heirloom or sentimental item the risk that a plated finish will eventually wear and require replating is documented at intake rather than discovered later. This is also where the shop stops competing on invented durability claims against sellers who make them freely.

included: the measured-band-plus-method form of a wear statement
naming what shortens and what extends wear life
documenting heirloom and sentimental risk at intake
the never-solid-gold rule
referring warranty decisions to the business
excluded: guaranteed wear-life figures or warranty periods
personalized advice about skin reactions or health
approving marketing wording
comparative durability claims against another shop's product

pros.claim: An honest structured answer is more persuasive at the counter than a number the customer half-suspects, and it survives the piece wearing
pros.example: a customer told the measured thickness, its class and what shortens it returns for replating rather than for a refund argument

pros.claim: Documenting heirloom risk at intake prevents the single most damaging category of dispute a plating shop can have
pros.example: a sentimental ring is accepted with a written note that the finish will wear and can be renewed, agreed before work starts

cons.claim: Refusing to give a number loses work to sellers who cheerfully invent one
cons.example: a competing listing promising years of wear wins the order from a shop that offered a band and a method

cons.claim: The structured statement takes time to explain and asks the customer to absorb nuance they did not ask for
cons.example: a quick counter sale turns into a five-minute conversation about wear zones and care

failure_modes: converting a thickness into a confident number of years
letting a listing or a tag imply solid gold
skipping the heirloom risk note because the customer seemed relaxed
quoting another shop's durability claim as a benchmark
acceptance_tests: every durability statement on file names the measured thickness, its method and zone, the wear class it corresponds to, and is expressed as a band with its shortening and extending factors
intake records for sentimental or heirloom items carry a written wear-and-replating risk note agreed before work started
revisit_triggers: returns show wear behaviour outside the band the statement used
the business adopts or changes a warranty position
a product's thickness class or deposit hardness changes

base.update_signal: returns show wear outside the band a statement relied on, or the business changes its warranty position

nodes.definition: Write one row per batch that a future person can reconstruct the whole job from, and write it before the parts move to stock rather than afterwards. The row carries the job and customer reference, the product and its qualification file, the stack, the bath or chemistry identity and its state as reported by the process side, the rack positions used, the witnesses created and where they are, every measurement with its zone, method, instrument and calibration verification, the adhesion results with their cohesive-or-adhesive calls and images, the sample actually taken against the sample planned, the disposition and who made it. Alongside the row sits a retained article - a witness or an accepted piece - bagged and labelled with the batch. The reason this is a work unit rather than an administrative afterthought is that without it, every later question is unanswerable: a returned piece cannot be tied to a bath state, a disputed thickness cannot be re-measured against the standard used, a claim cannot show its evidence, and a pattern across batches cannot be seen at all. The record is also what makes the shop's own improvement possible, since trends only exist where numbers were kept.

included: the per-batch row contents
retained witness or article per batch
recording planned versus actual sample
linking the batch to its qualification file and bath identity
filing before stock movement
excluded: the process side's own bath logs, which are referenced not duplicated
root-cause analysis entries, which belong to defect diagnosis
customer-facing statements themselves
accredited certificates, which are filed per product line

pros.claim: A complete row converts a future complaint from a mystery into a lookup
pros.example: a piece returned after months is traced to its batch, its bath state, its measured zones and its retained witness in minutes

pros.claim: Recording planned against actual sample makes deadline-driven shortcuts visible instead of invisible
pros.example: a month of records shows the sample shrinking on rush jobs, which is a management problem the shop can now see

cons.claim: The row takes real minutes per batch and is the first casualty of a busy day
cons.example: three rush jobs in an afternoon leave two rows half-filled and one missing entirely

cons.claim: Records accumulate obligations: once kept, they can be requested, and gaps become conspicuous
cons.example: a buyer audit that reviews the log finds the missing rows more damaging than no log at all would have been

failure_modes: filling the row from memory at the end of the week
recording numbers without their method, zone or calibration basis
consuming or discarding the retained article
letting parts move to stock before the row exists
acceptance_tests: every batch has a row containing job reference, qualification reference, stack, bath identity, rack positions, per-zone measurements with method and calibration basis, adhesion calls with images, planned versus actual sample, disposition and signer
a labelled retained witness or article exists for every accepted batch, and no batch record is dated after the parts moved to stock
revisit_triggers: a complaint cannot be traced to a batch
an audit or buyer requests records the current row does not contain
the recording format changes or a new instrument produces data the row has no field for

base.update_signal: a complaint cannot be traced to a batch from the existing rows, or an audit requests fields the record does not carry

nodes.definition: Close the job with one of four named outcomes and a person's name against it. Accept means every pre-written criterion was met at the marked zones, the adhesion evidence was read and recorded, the sample was taken as planned, the record row is complete and any claim-shaped wording has been through the compliance signer. Hold means something is unresolved - a method disagreement, an ambiguous adhesion call, a missing certificate, an incomplete sample - and the batch does not move until it is closed out. Refer means a failure has been identified and the job goes to defect diagnosis for root cause and to the approval path for any rework, which on customer goods requires documented consent before anything is stripped, since stripping chemistry carries the same safety obligation classes as plating and is never an informal step. Reject means the work is not recoverable and the material is routed accordingly. Two standing rules govern the decision: release is joint, so a thickness and adhesion pass does not release a piece the appearance gate has held, and borderline is not a disposition - a batch that cannot be accepted against its written criteria is held or referred, never shipped to see what the market says.

included: the four named outcomes and their preconditions
the named signer per disposition
joint release with the appearance gate
the no-borderline-shipping rule
referral into defect diagnosis and the documented-approval path for rework
excluded: performing the rework or the stripping
assigning root cause
approving claim wording
commercial negotiation about a failed job

pros.claim: Four named outcomes with a signer remove the informal fifth outcome, which is quietly shipping and hoping
pros.example: a batch that fails one zone is held with a name against it rather than going out with a mental note to watch for complaints

pros.claim: Joint release stops one gate's pass being used to override another gate's hold
pros.example: a batch with correct thickness and adhesion but a held colour verdict stays in the shop until both gates agree

cons.claim: Holds cost delivery dates and can strain a customer relationship that a shipped borderline batch would not have strained yet
cons.example: a wedding deadline is missed because a zone reading failed and the shop refused to ship on hope

cons.claim: Requiring a named signer concentrates responsibility, which is uncomfortable in a shop where one person signs everything
cons.example: the owner personally signs every disposition and becomes the bottleneck on release days

failure_modes: inventing a borderline category to move a deadline batch
releasing on thickness and adhesion while the appearance gate is still holding
stripping customer goods for rework without documented approval
signing a disposition before the record row is complete
acceptance_tests: every batch closes with exactly one of accept, hold, refer or reject, dated and signed, with the criteria it was judged against attached
no accepted batch exists whose sibling appearance gate is unresolved, and every rework of customer goods carries documented approval before stripping began
revisit_triggers: a held or referred batch reveals a criterion that was unworkable as written
a disposition is overturned after the fact
the shop's signer roles change
the rate of holds moves sharply in either direction

base.update_signal: a disposition is overturned after the fact, the hold rate moves sharply, or the shop's signer roles change

edges.why_related: the charter says this gate proves thickness against a specification, which only exists once the piece has been classed by the duty it will serve
the charter's insistence on measured rather than asserted evidence forces a sacrificial article to carry the destructive tests
the duty class decides how much barrier and load-carrying underlayer the stack needs beneath the gold
which zones count as worst case follows from how the piece is worn, so the duty class defines the map before it can be marked
the pre-written criteria are the duty class turned into numbers a batch can be measured against
the marked zones are what the non-destructive instrument is pointed at, and they decide whether the geometry is even measurable by that method
a flat ride-along witness is the substitute surface whenever the goods' geometry is smaller than the measuring spot
the method's answer is a calibrated inference, so stack-matched standards are the precondition that makes any of its numbers usable
the coulometric cell strips a defined spot, so it lives on witnesses rather than on saleable faces
a cross-check only means something when the non-destructive side of it was verified against the right standards first
the destructive charge-based result is the independent number the cross-check compares against
the band a figure is quoted with comes from how far the methods actually agree in this shop, not from an assumed precision
the battery can only include destructive members because witnesses exist to absorb them
the wrap is run only when selection has decided this product's stress justifies it and a witness of the right stock exists
the tape screen is assigned by selection, usually for geometries or substrates the severe members cannot reach
selection is where the goods-exclusion check happens, so the thermal member is only scheduled on articles that can survive it
the wrap produces exactly the ambiguous evidence - fine lines at a tight radius - that the call exists to resolve
post-quench blistering and lifting are read through the same crack-against-peel discrimination
sample size and rack spread are part of what is fixed before the run, so the plan is written inside the criteria
the routine batch check is the light half of the split, and it is exactly the sampling plan executed against an existing qualification
a claim class can only be mapped from a figure that carries its method, zone and band; a bare number cannot support a regulated word
the mapping is what reveals which conditions of a class in-house evidence cannot satisfy and therefore what must be sent out
the wear statement is built on a qualified measurement, so it inherits the method, zone and band of the figure it rests on
the recorded call and its image are one of the row's required contents and the thing a future dispute is answered with
a disposition is only signable once the row that supports it is complete, which is what stops parts moving before the evidence exists
a batch whose product line still lacks a required accredited certificate cannot be accepted for a market that requires it
the underlayer sits inside the same excited volume as the gold, so how thin and of what material it is constrains whether the gold figure can be separated from it at all
the sample is not free to be taken wherever it is convenient: it must reach the marked zones and span rack positions, which constrains how the plan can be executed

the destructive method is more direct and stronger on thin deposits while the non-destructive one is the only route to per-piece and per-zone acceptance on finished goods, and each is tempting to promote to sole anchor
edges.resolution_rule: neither becomes the sole anchor: the non-destructive method carries routine per-zone acceptance on goods, the destructive method anchors and periodically checks it on witnesses, and where they disagree beyond the shop's stated band the more direct method governs and the instrument is investigated

edges.why_related: the tape screen is fast, non-committal and almost always reassuring while the wrap is destructive and frequently uncomfortable, so schedule pressure pushes a shop toward the gentler evidence
edges.resolution_rule: a severe member outranks a gentle one whenever they disagree: an adhesive result at the wrap or the quench holds the batch regardless of a clean tape result, and no disposition may cite tape as its only adhesion evidence

edges.why_related: the sample costs the minutes that stand between a finished rack and a promised delivery, so the pressure to release on a reduced sample is strongest exactly when the risk of releasing is highest
edges.resolution_rule: the planned sample governs: a batch measured on less than its planned sample is a hold, not an accept, and any reduction is recorded with its reason and downgrades the confidence statement attached to the job

edges.why_related: the word the business wants on the tag implies a thickness class that may be heavier and costlier than the class the job was quoted and plated to
edges.resolution_rule: the measured deposit governs the word, never the reverse: if the specification the customer bought does not support the class, the wording is changed or the job is re-specified and re-quoted, and a structural condition such as a required base metal is never negotiable

edges.why_related: the customer at the counter wants a number of years before they will approve release, and the only honest answer is a band with a method attached
edges.resolution_rule: honesty governs the statement: the band, its method and its shortening factors are given, replating is offered as the answer to eventual wear, and any firmer promise is escalated to the business as a warranty decision rather than issued by the bench

edges.why_related: what the wrap shows is largely decided beneath the gold: a stressed, brittle underlayer cracks at the radius and takes the deposit with it, while a ductile one lets the stack survive forming
the calibration state at the time of measurement is what sets the band a figure can honestly be quoted with, and an unmatched stack turns that band into a stated limitation instead
rows accumulated across batches show where criteria were unreachable, routinely borderline or silently relaxed, which is the evidence that rewrites them for the next product revision
a hold or a referral is a signal that the qualification the routine check relies on no longer describes what the process is producing, which sends the product back for a fresh qualification lot
the duty class is settled first because it tells selection which stresses the product will really meet and therefore which battery members are worth their witnesses
both are battery members of the same standard family applied to coupons rather than to formed features, sharing witnesses and record fields while probing very different interface energies

conflict_axes.name: durability_class_versus_gold_cost
conflict_axes.description: A heavier wear class is the honest answer for a piece that will rub daily, and it consumes more gold and tank time than a fashion-price job can carry.
poles: specify the class the service duty demands
specify the class the price point can carry
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: state the class honestly and let price follow it; where the price cannot carry the duty, take the job at the lighter class only with the wear expectation disclosed in writing, or decline the specification

conflict_axes.name: non_destructive_convenience_versus_destructive_directness
conflict_axes.description: The instrument that can measure a finished ring gives a calibrated inference; the method that gives a direct answer destroys a defined area.
poles: measure the goods non-destructively
measure a witness destructively
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: run both in defined roles - non-destructive for per-zone acceptance on goods, destructive on witnesses to anchor and periodically check it - and let the more direct method govern disagreements beyond the stated band

conflict_axes.name: average_reading_versus_worst_case_point
conflict_axes.description: Averaging accessible readings makes a batch look comfortably in specification while the recess that will wear through first was never measured.
poles: report a representative average
accept only at the thinnest, highest-wear point
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: acceptance is the worst-case zone reading; averages and proud-face readings are kept only as a racking and current-distribution signal, never as the pass number

conflict_axes.name: gentle_screen_versus_severe_probe
conflict_axes.description: The quick adhesion screen almost always passes and costs nothing; the severe members regularly find what the screen missed and cost witnesses, time and comfort.
poles: screen quickly and keep moving
stress the interface as hard as service will
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: select the battery per goods before the run, keep gentle members as screens only, and let any severe-member failure outrank a gentle-member pass

conflict_axes.name: verification_minutes_versus_batch_throughput
conflict_axes.description: The per-batch routine is the recurring cost of the whole gate, and it is the first thing a deadline attacks.
poles: run the plan as written
ship the rack and catch up on records later
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the planned sample and the record row are release preconditions rather than paperwork; a batch short of either is a hold, and reductions are recorded so the erosion is visible to management

conflict_axes.name: in_house_number_versus_claimable_evidence
conflict_axes.description: Shop measurements are excellent for catching drift and useless as the basis of a regulated or buyer-facing claim, and the two get quietly conflated when a certificate is slow.
poles: use the number the shop already has
wait for accredited evidence before claiming
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: keep the two registers separate in writing: in-house figures drive process control and internal disposition, accredited certificates drive claims, and no claim ever cites an in-house screen where an accredited class is required

conflict_axes.name: customer_wants_a_promise_versus_measured_band
conflict_axes.description: Buyers ask how many years the finish will last and competitors answer freely; the technically honest answer is a band with a method and a list of what shortens it.
poles: give a reassuring figure
give a measured band with its method
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the bench issues bands and methods only; firmer commitments are warranty decisions escalated to the business, and heirloom or sentimental risk is documented at intake before work begins

conflict_axes.name: witness_burn_versus_evidence_strength
conflict_axes.description: Every strong piece of evidence consumes gold-bearing witnesses, and the temptation on small or precious runs is to skip the witness rather than pay for it.
poles: preserve gold and rack space
generate evidence that can be defended
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: budget witness consumption into the job at quotation so it is a priced input rather than a discretionary saving; where a job genuinely cannot carry a witness, record that as a stated limitation on every number and claim from it

conflict_axes.name: testing_the_goods_versus_protecting_them
conflict_axes.description: The most informative tests are exactly the ones that can damage a customer's piece, and some goods exclude them entirely.
poles: get the strongest evidence available
return the customer's piece untouched
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: goods protection wins by default: destructive evidence comes from witnesses, any test on customer goods requires documented consent and a hidden location, and where the goods exclude a method the resulting evidence gap is written into the statement rather than glossed over

conflict_axes.name: requalify_now_versus_trust_a_running_process
conflict_axes.description: A qualification file that still passes its routine checks is comfortable to keep using, and every change that quietly invalidated it looked minor at the time.
poles: keep producing against the existing qualification
stop and run a fresh qualification lot
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: requalification is triggered by a written change list rather than by judgement, and any change argued to be minor is recorded with that argument so a later failure can be traced to the decision

edge_cases.description: A narrow shank or a thin wire is smaller than the instrument's measuring spot, so the reading mixes in air and neighbouring angles and quietly under-reads the local thickness
edge_cases.trigger: the marked worst-case zone is a curved or narrow feature with no flat area large enough for the spot
edge_cases.mitigation: use small-spot collimation where available, otherwise take the number from a flat ride-along witness and record the geometry substitution as a stated limitation on that figure

edge_cases.description: A calibration standard built for a different substrate family is used on the shop's actual stack and returns a confidently wrong thickness that is off by a large multiple rather than a few percent
edge_cases.trigger: a new substrate or stack enters production and the existing standard set is used because it is the one in the drawer
edge_cases.mitigation: block measurement until a stack-matched standard is available or a destructive witness measurement anchors the session, and retract and re-measure any numbers already recorded against the wrong standard

edge_cases.description: A composition reading taken through a very thin flash reports the underlayer as part of the gold and under-states fineness, and the operator adjusts it upward to something that looks right
edge_cases.trigger: a fineness or karat question is asked about a decorative flash rather than about a thick deposit
edge_cases.mitigation: take fineness only from a deposit thick enough that the underlayer does not dominate, use a thick witness for that purpose, and route any claimable fineness question to the accredited route rather than adjusting a reading

edge_cases.description: A customer asks for a piece to be tagged vermeil when its core is a base metal, and the thickness is more than sufficient
edge_cases.trigger: a claim class is requested whose base-metal condition the article structurally cannot satisfy
edge_cases.mitigation: flag the class as structurally unavailable regardless of thickness, offer the wording the construction can support, verify the current jurisdiction rules, and route the decision to the designated compliance signer rather than settling it at the bench

edge_cases.description: A sample taken entirely from one corner of the rack passes comfortably while pieces from the shielded middle are materially thinner
edge_cases.trigger: the sample is collected at the end of a shift from whichever pieces are nearest
edge_cases.mitigation: enforce the rack-position spread written into the plan, record which positions were sampled, and treat a single-position sample as an incomplete sample and therefore a hold

edge_cases.description: The bent witness shows fine crazing across the outer radius on a hard deposit and the operator scraps a sound batch
edge_cases.trigger: a hard, low-ductility deposit is wrapped at or near its own diameter during a routine check
edge_cases.mitigation: inspect under magnification for lifted edges and exposure of the layer beneath, photograph the area into the record, call cohesive crazing what it is, and reserve rejection for genuine lifting or ambiguity

edge_cases.description: An heirloom arrives already carrying an unknown existing deposit, and the measured figure is the total stack rather than the new gold the shop applied
edge_cases.trigger: a replating job on customer goods whose plating history is unknown
edge_cases.mitigation: record at intake that pre-existing deposit is present and unquantified, measure a witness of the new deposit separately where possible, state every figure as total stack unless a witness separates it, and document the wear-and-replating risk before work begins

edge_cases.description: A stone-set, soldered or enamelled piece cannot take the thermal member of the battery, leaving the strongest interface evidence unavailable for that job
edge_cases.trigger: the selected battery includes a member the goods must never see
edge_cases.mitigation: run the excluded member on a witness of the same stack, record the exclusion and its reason in the job file, and carry the reduced evidence strength into the statement made about the job

edge_cases.description: A coulometric electrolyte specified for one coating and substrate pair is used on a different stack and stops at the wrong interface, producing a plausible but wrong endpoint
edge_cases.trigger: a new stack is measured with whichever electrolyte is already fitted to the cell
edge_cases.mitigation: match the electrolyte to the coating and substrate pair from its own documentation before measuring, record the pairing with every result, and confirm any surprising endpoint against a cross-section before acting on it

edge_cases.description: Stripping electrolyte and pickling acid end up on the same shelf or in the same rinse route because both are 'just QC chemicals'
edge_cases.trigger: test reagents are stored or drained outside the plating room's segregation scheme
edge_cases.mitigation: hold every test reagent to the plating room's obligation classes - segregated labelled storage, no shared drain, documented handling, personal protection and ventilation as its documentation requires - with the jurisdiction's workplace and hazmat rules verified and formal training rather than improvised procedure

edge_cases.description: A customer presses for a number of years of wear before approving the job and treats any band as evasion
edge_cases.trigger: a durability promise is made a condition of the order at the counter
edge_cases.mitigation: give the measured thickness with its method and zone, the wear class it corresponds to as a band, the factors that shorten it and the replating path, and escalate any request for a firmer commitment to the business as a warranty decision rather than answering it at the bench

edge_cases.description: A mixed order contains a sterling piece and a base-metal piece finished identically, and one tag wording is written for the whole order
edge_cases.trigger: a single claim class is applied across an order with more than one base metal
edge_cases.mitigation: map the claim class per piece rather than per order, record the base metal against each item in the batch row, and refer the per-item wording to the compliance signer with the structural conditions identified

workflow.action: Fix what this gate proves and where everything else is referred
workflow.description: Write the charter: thickness against a specification and adhesion to the substrate are owned here; appearance, root cause and claim approval are referred
workflow.gate: the two owned claims, the three referral destinations and the measured-or-estimated statement rule are written down

workflow.action: Class the piece by the service duty it will actually see
workflow.description: Turn how the piece is worn into a named wear class and the thickness specification it implies, at quotation rather than at inspection
workflow.artifact: wear class and thickness specification on the job ticket
workflow.gate: the ticket names the class, the per-zone specification and the basis for it, and the quoted price and cycle time correspond to that class

workflow.action: Mark the worst-case measurement zones on the job
workflow.description: Identify the low-current-density and high-wear features on a photograph or sketch and designate them as the acceptance points
workflow.artifact: marked zone map for the job
workflow.gate: the map exists before the run and includes at least one low-current-density zone and one high-wear zone

workflow.action: Write the acceptance criteria before anything is plated
workflow.description: Fix per-zone thickness criteria, the underlayer window, the named adhesion members and their pass conditions, the sample and the borderline rule
workflow.artifact: pre-written acceptance criteria on the job ticket
workflow.gate: the criteria are dated before the plating run and anything that could not be fixed in advance is present as a written limitation

workflow.action: Fix the sampling plan and the first-article check
workflow.description: Decide sample size against the shop's written rule, the rack positions to be sampled and the first-article gate before the batch proceeds
workflow.artifact: sampling plan entry in the batch record
workflow.gate: planned sample size and rack spread are recorded before the run and the first article is measured before the rest of the batch moves on

workflow.action: Hang the witnesses with the work
workflow.description: Rack same-stack coupons and offcuts in comparable positions so destructive evidence exists without touching saleable goods
workflow.artifact: labelled witnesses with recorded rack positions
workflow.gate: at least one same-stack witness per run is recorded with its position, and the witness gold is in the job's material budget

workflow.action: Measure thickness at the marked zones and cross-check the methods
workflow.description: Verify instrument calibration against stack-matched standards, measure every marked zone, confirm on a witness by the destructive method at the stated interval, and apply the governing-method rule to any disagreement
workflow.artifact: per-zone measurement set with calibration verification and cross-check result
workflow.gate: a dated calibration verification precedes the readings, every marked zone has a reading with its method, and any disagreement beyond the stated band is closed by arbitration or an identified instrument fault

workflow.action: Run the selected adhesion battery on the witnesses
workflow.description: Execute the members chosen for these goods, applying the goods-exclusion check before any thermal member is scheduled
workflow.gate: every selected member has a result against its written pass condition, and each excluded member is recorded with its reason and substitute evidence

workflow.action: Read crack against peel under magnification and record the call
workflow.description: Discriminate cohesive cracking from adhesive lifting on each tested witness, photograph the area and apply the conservative rule to ambiguous cases
workflow.artifact: adhesion call with magnified image per test
workflow.gate: each call states cohesive or adhesive with its magnification and image, and every adhesive or ambiguous call routes to hold and referral

workflow.action: Map the measured evidence onto the claim classes and flag the wording
workflow.description: State which class the measurements would support, which conditions remain unmet or are structurally impossible, and hand the wording to the compliance signer after verifying current jurisdiction rules
workflow.artifact: claim class mapping entry in the product file
workflow.gate: the mapping records measured evidence, supported class, unmet conditions and the date jurisdiction rules were verified, and no wording is released without the compliance signer's recorded decision

workflow.action: Complete the verification record row and retain the sample
workflow.description: Fill the batch row with job, qualification, stack, bath identity, rack positions, measurements with methods, adhesion calls, planned against actual sample and disposition, and bag a labelled retained article
workflow.artifact: batch verification record row plus retained witness or article
workflow.gate: the row is complete and dated before any part moves to stock, and a labelled retained article exists for the batch

workflow.action: Sign one of the four dispositions
workflow.description: Close the batch as accept, hold, refer or reject with a named signer, releasing jointly with the appearance gate and never on a borderline
workflow.artifact: signed disposition attached to the batch record
workflow.gate: exactly one dated and signed outcome exists, the appearance gate is resolved, and any rework of customer goods carries documented approval before stripping

dominance_rules.rule: Chemical safety and segregation obligations dominate every test choice
dominance_rules.rationale: test reagents include stripping electrolytes of cyanide- and thiourea-bearing classes and strong acids, and a segregation failure is unrecoverable in a way that a missed measurement is not
dominance_rules.trigger: any test reagent is selected, stored, used or disposed of, or a test procedure would have to be improvised
dominance_rules.action: apply the plating room's obligation classes in full - segregated labelled storage, no shared drain between cyanide-class and acid streams, documented handling with the ventilation and personal protection its documentation requires, formal training rather than improvisation - and verify the jurisdiction's workplace and hazmat rules before proceeding

dominance_rules.rule: Protection of the customer's goods dominates the strength of the evidence
dominance_rules.rationale: a destroyed customer piece is an unrecoverable harm, while a weaker evidence route can be disclosed and compensated for
dominance_rules.trigger: a test that could damage the goods is proposed on the goods themselves
dominance_rules.action: move the test to a witness, and where the goods exclude the method entirely record the exclusion and carry the reduced evidence strength into every statement about that job

dominance_rules.rule: Measured evidence dominates the word anyone wants on the tag
dominance_rules.rationale: a claim class is a compliance obligation whose conditions the article either meets or does not, and a structural condition such as a required base metal cannot be met by any amount of gold
dominance_rules.trigger: a requested marketing term implies a class the measurements or the construction do not support
dominance_rules.action: state which class the evidence supports, flag the gap, verify current jurisdiction rules, and route the wording to the designated compliance signer without approving it at the bench

dominance_rules.rule: The worst-case zone reading dominates any average or proud-face reading
dominance_rules.rationale: wear-through starts where the deposit is thinnest, so an average describes a piece that does not exist
dominance_rules.trigger: an acceptance decision is about to be made from averaged or convenient readings
dominance_rules.action: judge acceptance at the marked zones only and keep the other readings as a racking and current-distribution signal

dominance_rules.rule: A severe adhesion result dominates a gentle one that disagrees
dominance_rules.rationale: the gentle members detect only gross failure, so a clean tape result carries far less information than a wrap or quench failure
dominance_rules.trigger: a gentle member passes while a severe member shows lifting, flaking or blistering
dominance_rules.action: hold the batch on the severe result and refer it, regardless of how many gentle results passed

dominance_rules.rule: Accredited evidence dominates in-house numbers for anything leaving the shop as a claim
dominance_rules.rationale: in-house screens control the process and do not satisfy a regulator or a trade buyer, and a home-built exposure setup controls none of the variables a standard controls
dominance_rules.trigger: a claim, listing, certificate response or buyer questionnaire is about to cite a shop measurement
dominance_rules.action: cite only accredited results where an accredited class is required, and hold the claim until the certificate exists rather than substituting a comparative screen

dominance_rules.rule: Pre-written acceptance criteria dominate any criterion proposed after the results are known
dominance_rules.rationale: criteria written after seeing results always pass, which turns the whole gate into a formality
dominance_rules.trigger: a batch misses a written criterion and a revised interpretation is suggested
dominance_rules.action: judge the batch against the criteria as written, and change criteria only by a dated revision that applies to future work

dominance_rules.rule: The planned sample and the complete record dominate the delivery date
dominance_rules.rationale: a batch released without its sample or its row cannot be defended, diagnosed or traced when it comes back
dominance_rules.trigger: schedule pressure proposes releasing on a reduced sample or with the record to be completed later
dominance_rules.action: hold the batch, record the reduction and its reason if one was taken, and treat the missing evidence as a hold condition rather than an accepted risk

dominance_rules.rule: Documented approval dominates any rework initiative on customer goods
dominance_rules.rationale: stripping is irreversible, can damage the substrate and carries the same chemical obligation classes as plating, so it is never a bench decision on someone else's property
dominance_rules.trigger: a failed batch of customer goods is a candidate for strip and replate
dominance_rules.action: refer to the defect and rework path, obtain and file documented approval before any stripping begins, and apply the same safety obligation classes as the plating operation

dominance_rules.rule: An honest band with its method dominates a requested wear-life figure
dominance_rules.rationale: wear life depends on thickness, hardness, geometry, skin chemistry and habit, so a converted number of years is invention rather than measurement
dominance_rules.trigger: a customer or a listing asks for a durability guarantee
dominance_rules.action: give the measured thickness with its method and zone, the class band, the shortening factors and the replating path, and escalate any firmer commitment to the business as a warranty decision

dominance_rules.rule: An unverified instrument dominates a convenient number
dominance_rules.rationale: a wrongly calibrated reading is a confident number that gets repeated to a customer, which is worse than having no number at all
dominance_rules.trigger: a measuring session begins without a dated verification against a stack-matched standard
dominance_rules.action: verify first or take the number destructively from a witness, and mark any session on an unmatched stack so its limitation travels with every figure

anti_rework_rules.rule: Class the service duty and fix the thickness specification at quotation, before the job is priced or plated
anti_rework_rules.prevents: plating a job to a class the customer's real use will destroy, then stripping and redoing it at the shop's cost after it fails its own criteria

anti_rework_rules.rule: Mark the worst-case zones and write the acceptance criteria before the first part enters the tank
anti_rework_rules.prevents: criteria invented around whichever readings came back, and the discovery at inspection that the zone that mattered was never measurable

anti_rework_rules.rule: Verify the instrument against a stack-matched standard before the measuring session, not after a surprising result
anti_rework_rules.prevents: retracting and re-measuring a whole session of confidently wrong numbers, some of which have already been quoted to customers

anti_rework_rules.rule: Hang the witnesses with the work in comparable rack positions rather than plating coupons separately later
anti_rework_rules.prevents: destructive evidence that describes a different run, and a batch released on adhesion results that never represented it

anti_rework_rules.rule: Run the goods-exclusion check before scheduling any thermal or destructive test on customer property
anti_rework_rules.prevents: damaging a stone-set, soldered or enamelled piece in the act of testing it, which no measurement result can undo

anti_rework_rules.rule: Run the full battery on a qualification lot before the first production batch of a product
anti_rework_rules.prevents: discovering an adhesion or thickness problem across several shipped batches instead of on one deliberately sacrificed lot

anti_rework_rules.rule: Map the claim class and identify the accredited tests a product needs at launch, not when a buyer asks
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a product already listed and shipping into a regulated market while its required testing has weeks of lead time still to run

anti_rework_rules.rule: Record the wear-and-replating risk for heirloom and sentimental items at intake, before any work starts
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an irreconcilable dispute about a piece whose owner believed a plated finish was permanent

anti_rework_rules.rule: Complete the batch record row and bag the retained article before any part moves to stock
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a later complaint that cannot be tied to a bath state, a rack position or a measurement, leaving no way to answer it or to fix the cause

anti_rework_rules.rule: Write the requalification trigger list when the qualification file is created
anti_rework_rules.prevents: production running for months against a qualification whose stack, chemistry, rack or instrument no longer exists, with no way to identify which change caused the failure

iteration_protocol.trigger: the non-destructive and destructive methods disagree beyond the shop's stated band
iteration_protocol.action: apply the governing-method rule, investigate the instrument and its calibration, and settle the case by cross-section arbitration if it remains open before any batch is released on either number

iteration_protocol.trigger: a marked worst-case zone fails while the proud faces pass comfortably
iteration_protocol.action: hold the batch, record the proud-to-recess ratio, and refer the current-path and racking question to the process side before running the product again

iteration_protocol.trigger: an adhesive failure is called on a witness
iteration_protocol.action: stop release for the batch, refer to defect diagnosis for root cause, and treat the product's qualification as invalid until a fresh qualification lot passes the full battery

iteration_protocol.trigger: any item on the requalification trigger list occurs - a stack, chemistry, rack, geometry, instrument or dormancy change
iteration_protocol.action: schedule a qualification lot with witnesses and run the full thickness and adhesion set before further production batches are released against the old file

iteration_protocol.trigger: the instrument is serviced, moved, left idle beyond the shop's interval, or a standard is damaged or expires
iteration_protocol.action: re-verify against stack-matched standards, re-measure any open batches whose numbers came from the affected sessions, and mark the affected records

iteration_protocol.trigger: a customer, buyer or regulator disputes a recorded thickness, fineness or claim
iteration_protocol.action: reconstruct the figure from the record, re-run the governing method, escalate to cross-section arbitration or accredited testing as the dispute requires, and correct the claim wording through the compliance signer if the evidence does not support it

iteration_protocol.trigger: the shop enters a new selling jurisdiction or the applicable guides, standards or release rules are revised
iteration_protocol.action: re-verify the claim class conditions and the accredited test set for every affected product line and re-check existing tag and listing wording before further sales

iteration_protocol.trigger: the record shows repeated near-misses, shrinking samples or wear-through returns inside the stated band
iteration_protocol.action: revise the acceptance criteria, the sample rule or the wear class for that product line by a dated revision, and update the durability statements that rested on the old band

priority_rationale: The frame and specification nodes come first because nothing can be measured until the piece has been classed by its service duty, the stack has been specified, the worst-case zones have been marked and the acceptance criteria have been written; the measurement-basis and method nodes follow because witnesses, calibrated instruments and a cross-check rule are what turn a reading into evidence, and a qualified statement is what turns evidence into something that can be repeated safely; adhesion selection and its battery members sit alongside them because they consume the same witnesses and feed the same crack-against-peel call; sampling and the qualification split then decide how much of that evidence a batch has to carry; and the compliance, record and disposition nodes come last because they compose everything upstream into a claim class referral, a durability statement, a traceable row and one signed outcome that a shop can defend.
